corrections.ai_statement: CAMS AOD550 was never taken to a forecasting experiment.
corrections.actual_repository_fact: Stage 8.6B WAS EXECUTED and REJECTED. CAMS AOD550 and TCWV were extracted for 347 origins and evaluated under 5-fold EVEN CV. Candidate EVEN MAE was 37.867306 W/m2 vs Control 37.620054 W/m2 (+0.247252 W/m2 degradation). Failed 4 of 6 decision gates.
Stage 8.7 tested MEPS DNI-anchored direct/diffuse proxy decomposition. EVEN CV candidate MAE degraded by +11.825787 W/m2 (49.445841 vs 37.620054 W/m2 control), 0/5 folds improved.

corrections.ai_statement: Omitted or treated as an unexamined open route.
corrections.actual_repository_fact: Stage 8.9A systematically evaluated 6 candidate independent cloud data sources (NASA VIIRS, Meteosat SEVIRI/MTG, Ceilometer, All-Sky Imager, Cloud Motion Vectors). All failed feasibility due to dissemination latency (3-8h), polar night optical masking, extreme parallax shift (>20.9 km), or mountainous terrain separation.

impact_on_route_authorization: Prevents accidental re-opening of closed/rejected routes (CAMS Stage 8.6, DNI Stage 8.7, Independent Cloud Stage 8.9A) based on incomplete external evidence packets.
